question: Why do actions not bind the Lord?
premises: Actions do not bind the Lord.
The Lord sits indifferent and unattached.
Attachment is absent in those actions.
inference: Non-attachment keeps the Lord free from karmic bondage.
uncertainties: The fused compound is kept whole.
plain_english: Those actions do not bind me, wealth-winner, seated like an indifferent one, unattached in those actions.
